messages.subject: Columns dropped in output part5
parts:
Hello,

I keep experiencing the following error for part5. "1: Columns dropped in output part5 for dummyfilename.gt3x.RData because these could not be matched to columns for earlier recordings in this dataset. Please check whether these recordings were processed with a different GGIR version or configuration. If yes, reprocess consistently. If not, consider renaming this file such that it is alphabetically first and by that processed first, which should address the issue."

These data are all being processed at one time and in a fresh output directory. I tried renaming and still get the issue with other files. Any ideas on what to do are appreciated.

Thanks,

Sam
